paper.title: QLoRA hyperparameters (Appendix B) applied to the toy pipeline

note: Paper (Guanaco): LLaMA 7B-65B, NF4 + double quantization, bf16 compute, LoRA r=64 alpha=16 on all linear layers, dropout 0.1 (7B/13B) or 0.05 (33B/65B), lr 2e-4 (7B/13B) or 1e-4 (33B/65B), batch 16, constant schedule, max grad norm 0.3, paged AdamW; OASST1 for 1875 steps. Real runs need bitsandbytes + PEFT + transformers on a GPU (install the 'hf' extra); this config mirrors the optimiser settings on the toy model.
